commits.summary: Installer runs Dafny and Boogie on hosts with only .NET 10
Verification report names the machine of every result and calibrates estimates per machine
Results record the runner's machine name, and the installer provides jsonschema
Record verification results for 60 jobs, the first run on the vm-1 VM
The verification runner stops a step past its timeout only when it has stalled; the installer puts GNU coreutils first on Ubuntu 26.04
